rows.text: An even fight at equal tier is won 50% of the time, within 5 points
A first tool reaches level 5 within 10 minutes of play
A tier-2 item reaches level 20 in 35 to 45 world days of daily play
No tag pairing wins more than 35% of the matchup matrix
No sampled kind exceeds its tier budget
Per tier and slot, the best kind a search finds is within 1.3 times the top decile of sampled kinds, by the sum of the two strongest axes
From 100 players up, coin per active character stays between 350 and 450 coin for 42 simulated days

At 10 players over a 120-day soak, coin per active character stays between a quarter of the band's floor and twice its ceiling over the last two thirds, and its distance to the band over the last third is no worse than over the middle third by more than a quarter of the band's width
An unattended world still has every settlement standing after 90 world days
An unattended world has at most 3 regions overrun on day 90, and at least half its regions' threat still moves 60 or more over days 60 to 90
An admin staging without limit moves no price in another settlement by more than 5%
Every pattern point, and every starting settlement, is reachable on foot from every starting settlement, on 1,000 sampled seeds and out to 200 tiles
A tile's generation reads only a bounded neighbourhood: the same tile gives the same baseline whichever chunks were generated first
At least 1 newly generated region in 3 holds something its server has not seen, at every distance band out to 200 tiles
Biomes sprawl: the median land tile stands in a connected patch of one biome of at least 300 tiles
Between 10% and 20% of land tiles are ecotones, where two biomes fade into each other
A world day's cost grows with discovered regions, not generated ones
A new character's first class unlocks in 5 to 9 world days of daily play
No class's abilities win more than 30% of the matchup matrix on their own
No guild work returns more than it consumes, at any guild size
A mount on its terrain shortens a 12-tile journey by 25% to 40%
Finds from triggers never add goods: the spoils pool is conserved
A guild of 5 can found a settlement within 10 world days
A party at the expected practice level solves a floor's puzzle within its countdown 60% to 80% of the time
In 90 unattended world days, no region's gauge stays pinned at 0 or at its maximum for more than 7 world days in a row
In 90 unattended world days, no faction loses its last holding
A snapshot plus recorded actions replays to the same digest
A second NPC meeting raises a topic from the player's own history in 60% or more of meetings
Two players with different histories with one NPC see different top topics in 80% or more of cases
A world day costs the same whether the world holds 10 saved NPCs or 1,000,000

NPCs pass on a neighbour's news one hop deep, bring up crowding at 10 structures built in their region within 14 world days, some move home, and every route is relaid at the first meeting after a week
A party of 2 at equal tier wins within 5 points of a lone character's rate at that tier
A party of 3 at equal tier wins within 5 points of a lone character's rate at that tier
A party of 4 at equal tier wins within 5 points of a lone character's rate at that tier
A party at the expected practice solves a big rewire within its countdown 60% to 80% of the time, at 2, 3 and 4 seats
A party at the expected practice solves a split panel within its countdown 60% to 80% of the time, at 2, 3 and 4 seats
A party at the expected practice solves a two-hand lock within its countdown 60% to 80% of the time, at 2, 3 and 4 seats
A party at the expected practice solves a relay chain within its countdown 60% to 80% of the time, at 2, 3 and 4 seats
A party at the expected practice solves a boiler room within its countdown 60% to 80% of the time, at 2, 3 and 4 seats
A party at the expected practice solves a pipe crew within its countdown 60% to 80% of the time, at 2, 3 and 4 seats
A party at the expected practice solves a tension-and-pick lock within its countdown 60% to 80% of the time, at 2, 3 and 4 seats
A party at the expected practice solves a two-axis tilt within its countdown 60% to 80% of the time, at 2, 3 and 4 seats
A party at the expected practice solves a split grid within its countdown 60% to 80% of the time, at 2, 3 and 4 seats
A party at the expected practice solves a bomb squad within its countdown 60% to 80% of the time, at 2, 3 and 4 seats
A party at the expected practice solves a call-and-answer override within its countdown 60% to 80% of the time, at 2, 3 and 4 seats
A party at the expected practice solves a tandem winch within its countdown 60% to 80% of the time, at 2, 3 and 4 seats
A party at the expected practice solves a double swipe within its countdown 60% to 80% of the time, at 2, 3 and 4 seats
A party at the expected practice solves a panel array within its countdown 60% to 80% of the time, at 2, 3 and 4 seats
A party at the expected practice solves a relay solder within its countdown 60% to 80% of the time, at 2, 3 and 4 seats
Over 1,000 seeds every dungeon runs 3 to 7 floors, deeper with its entrance's tier, and has a guardian
Every floor above a dungeon's bottom forks into two ways and a hidden third, each of one to three tags
In 90 unattended world days, what is lost on a floor is only ever found there: floor pools add no goods
A hunt's spoils roll once within its row, and the parts paid to its pressers sum to the roll
A dungeon turns haunted at 5 falls inside 14 world days and calms once a window passes with fewer
party-help and every party version's rate are what the versions' own solvers measure, not a guess
The same history gives the same content twice
Two histories differing in a tile's neighbourhood give different content in 60% or more of tiles
A pin changes no tile outside its radius, and none discovered before it
Every pinned slot and drawn dungeon entrance is reachable from the first settlement, on every history and with pins on 1,000 seeds
A tile's draw costs the same on day 1 and day 300 of a busy world
Dungeons drawn from history keep their kind's floors, a guardian and distinct ways

A 14-day season zero has, on every seed, a stage decided by players (won, its mark met by 2 or more distinct backers) and a stage that lapsed, writes its finale and its close, keeps the ledger clean, and replays to the same digest
A city takes most of a season: the first city lands between world day 22 and 42
With troubles on, an unattended world loses no starting settlement and leaves no ruin after 90 world days
In 90 unattended world days with the director on, at least one arc lapses on every seed and no stage is won
In 90 unattended world days with the director on, no faction loses its last holding
The director's world day in the week to day 90 costs no more with its memory ring full than 110% of the day as played: a predicate pays for what it recalls, not for what the ring holds

On every 1,000-player seed of the closed world, agents never told of emergence make a style, its region's variant, the variant's found material and a kind made from it, with no operator command and no staged fact
Every promotion type (road, camp, haunt, route, style, variant, legend, custom) fires at least once on some world of the closed-world run
Adaptation brakes reliance: for every variant with 14 days left, its style's share of the region's wins in the 14 days after is below the 14 days before
A day's trace intake and turn with 100,000 stale entries costs no more than 110% of the day as played: traces cost what is touched
